summary: Presenter sync feature testing COMPLETE - All features working correctly. Backend: PUT /api/shows/titles/{id} now syncs presenter_ids to all shows when default_presenter_ids are updated. Frontend: Presenters display correctly on Calendar sidebar, Show Detail page, and Rundown Editor. Backstage Radio correctly shows 2 presenters: Yannick Gijbels and Hadewig Weyen.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend shows.py lines 183-193: Presenter sync correctly updates all shows with matching title when default_presenter_ids changes
ShowDetailPage.js: Window focus listener added to refetch show data - ensures presenter updates reflect when user returns from editing
RundownEditor.js: Key prop added with presenter IDs to force re-render when presenters change
CalendarPage.js: Window focus listener added to refetch shows - sidebar shows presenter info correctly
seed_data_creation: Backstage Radio title pre-configured with 2 presenters (Yannick Gijbels, Hadewig Weyen), synced to 52 shows
context_for_next_testing_agent: Presenter sync feature fully working. Backstage Radio has 52 scheduled shows all synced with 2 presenters. The sync happens automatically when updating default_presenter_ids on show title via PUT /api/shows/titles/{id}. Frontend components (CalendarPage, ShowDetailPage, RundownEditor) have window focus listeners to refetch data when user returns.

Show Management - Update presenters on s.details: PUT /api/shows/titles/{id} endpoint correctly syncs presenter_ids to all shows with that title. Verified: 52 Backstage Radio shows all have presenter_ids synced.

Calendar Page - Presenters in sidebar.details: Calendar sidebar shows 'Yannick Gijbels, Hadewig Weyen' for Backstage Radio shows when clicking on a day with shows. Users icon with presenter names displayed.

Show Detail Page - Presenters display.details: Show Detail page shows 'Presenters:' label with 'Yannick Gijbels' and 'Hadewig Weyen' displayed as badges in the Show Details section.

Rundown Editor - Presenters display.details: Rundown section shows 'Presenters:' label with both presenter names as badges at the top of the rundown editor.

Show Management - Presenters in title li.details: Show Management page displays 'Yannick Gijbels' and 'Hadewig Weyen' next to Backstage Radio in the show titles list.
